name: VC Dimension / Self-Directed Queries Complexity
details: Refuted: self-directed query complexity has no upper bound that depends only on VC dimension.  Ben-David--Eiron construct, for every fixed $d\geq3$ and arbitrarily large $n$, a finite class $\mathcal C^d_n$ with $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal C^d_n)=d$ and $\mathrm{SDC}(\mathcal C^d_n)=\Theta(n)$.
proof: Lemma 1 of the cited paper constructs the classes $\mathcal C^d_n$ and establishes the displayed fixed-VC, unbounded-self-directed-complexity behavior.  Consequently no function of VC dimension alone can universally upper-bound $\mathrm{SDC}$.
